Preconditions:

[PRE:RESET_CART]

Registered user {{USER_EMAIL}} starts with this SKU already in their account cart at a quantity such that adding the guest-cart quantity on merge would exceed available stock. Design Technique: Boundary Value Analysis (merge-time quantity summation crossing the stock ceiling).
Steps:
[NAV] log in to {{FRONT_URL}} as {{USER_EMAIL}}
[NAV] navigate to {{FRONT_URL}}/seed-test-fixtures/agent-test-low-stock-fixture
[ACT] set quantity to just over half of available stock
[ACT] add to cart
[WAIT] wait for the cart mutation to settle (cart badge updates or items[] reflects the new/updated line — addItem async settle)
[ACT] click the account button in the top header (BL-AUTH-007, data-test-id="account-button")
[WAIT] wait for the account menu popup to open
[ACT] click 'Logout' in the account menu popup (data-test-id="sign-out-button")
[WAIT] wait for signed-out state confirmed
[NAV] navigate to {{FRONT_URL}} as guest
[NAV] navigate to {{FRONT_URL}}/seed-test-fixtures/agent-test-low-stock-fixture
[ACT] set quantity to just over half of available stock
[ACT] add to cart as guest (so user-qty + guest-qty > available stock)
[WAIT] wait for the cart mutation to settle (cart badge updates or items[] reflects the new/updated line — addItem async settle)
[ACT] sign in with {{USER_EMAIL}} / {{USER_PASSWORD}} (triggers merge)
[NAV] navigate to {{FRONT_URL}}/cart
Assertions:
[STATE] the merge retains the raw summed quantity (user qty + guest qty) even though it exceeds available stock — the excess is NOT silently accepted without any signal; the line is explicitly flagged with a stock-exceeded validation message {OBSERVED} (live-verified: merge produced qty=6 against stock=5 for @td(PROD_LOW_STOCK.sku)/QA-LOW-001 — it is NOT capped to 5)
[DOM] the merged line shows the verbatim message "You can order maximum 5 item(s)", the '+' control is disabled, and "In stock 5" is shown {OBSERVED} (live-verified as real reactive validation, not a static banner — reducing the quantity to 5 made the message disappear immediately)
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[API] mergeCarts mutation response errors[] is empty
[API] getCart after merge: the line's quantity reflects the raw summed value (may exceed available stock) AND the line carries an explicit stock-validation flag/message when it does

[NETWORK] no 4xx/5xx during merge
[API] addItem mutation response errors[] is empty
Failure_Signals: merged quantity exceeds available stock with NO flag/message shown (silent oversell); checkout proceeds with an oversold quantity and no warning; the stock-exceeded message is a static label that does not react to a quantity change (does not disappear when qty is reduced to the stock limit); merge mutation errors[] non-empty with no user-facing explanation
